notes: Rucking gear reviews (packs, vests, plates, socks, base layers). Affiliate commissions; GORUCK supplied review units. Very high recent volume suggests bulk/SEO publishing; check enclosure MIME types (image enclosures).
Hands-on outdoor gear testing: boots, socks, gloves, layers, sleep systems, packs. Affiliate model.
Backcountry hunter reviews: rangefinding binoculars, packs, optics. Ad supported.
Tactical gear reviews and first looks. Industry-sponsored content is common.
Industry news, mostly manufacturer press releases (clothing, packs, power, ballistics). ~180 items/month and only 6 per feed page (use ?paged=N); needs heavy keyword filtering.
NRA publication. 'New:' product posts are close to press releases (mounts, bags, ballistic apps); treat as manufacturer claims. Mostly firearm content, so filter.
Mounts and shooting-position technique. Feed holds ~3 days of items; Python's default client may fail, use a browser user-agent.
Competition context and data-driven gear surveys. Low volume (~2 posts/month). Behind Cloudflare.
Same publisher as ruckauthority_feed. Pack, vest, and boot reviews.
Pack and ruck manufacturer; counterpoint to Ruck Authority's reviews. Low posting volume.
Pack manufacturer; promotes its own products. Gear-list videos suit multi-day events.
Optics, bipod, and accessory reviews. Also posts rifle reviews (out of scope), so filter. Sponsorships not checked.
Hunting media; rangefinding binocular reviews. Advertiser supported. Low in-scope volume.
Optics manufacturer and Mammoth Sniper Challenge title sponsor (mounts, ballistic app content).
Eyewear manufacturer. Makes a Vortex x Gatorz collaboration product (tie to title sponsor). Only eyewear source found.

Mountains, Mullets, Merica! (@MountainsMulletsMerica). Hands-on rangefinder, scope-camera, and ballistic-calculator testing (e.g. Element Seeker beam divergence and ballistic data). Also posts firearm and chassis videos (out of scope). Sponsorships not yet checked; frequent Element Seeker coverage may indicate a brand relationship.

Truth Then Freedom (@TruthThenFreedom). Competitor and trainer: long-term optic, thermal clip-on, reticle, and dry-fire gear evaluations plus match lessons (e.g. FAST Idaho). Low volume (~2-4 videos/month). Also covers suppressors and firearms (out of scope). Sponsorships not yet checked.

Cold Harbour Supply (@coldharboursupply). Night-vision and thermal RETAILER: its videos are overviews of products it sells, so treat them as manufacturer/retailer claims, not independent testing. Low volume (~2 videos/month).

Hunt Fish Shoot (@HuntFishShootChannel). One of the few creators who has covered the Mammoth Sniper Challenge directly (loadout videos). SPONSORED: partnered with MDT, which republishes its content on MDT's blog; treat its praise of MDT and partner products as sponsored, not independent. Mostly firearm reviews (out of scope) outside Mammoth season.
Same publisher as vortex_yt. Optics and layering episodes; many episodes off topic. Posts ~2 episodes/week, so max_items is 12 to cover 30 days.
Same publisher as rokslide_feed. Gear review episodes (packs, layers, food).
Run by Exo Mtn Gear (pack maker); practitioner gear Q&A but promotes its own brand.
Gear lists for multi-day backpack trips and optics. Publisher affiliation and sponsorships not verified.
Backcountry nutrition and hydration. Co-branded episode with Argali (who also appears on Vortex Nation).
Wolf Precision, a custom rifle builder: wind and scope-mounting episodes. Practitioner with a commercial interest; rifle episodes out of scope.
Precision Rifle Series league podcast; league has many industry sponsors (e.g. Leica optics episode).
